# clio compliance request-copy

Record one copy-inventory disposition for a request and report the request

## Usage

```
clio compliance request-copy --copy-id ID --request-id ID --custody CLASS --owner harness|system --required-action erase|remove|delivery|notice --state STATE [--exception-reason REASON] [--updated-at TIME] [--bank BANK] [--actor ACTOR] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

drives one durable subject request through the in-process subject-request tool, so the CLI and the MCP surface share one request path

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--copy-id ID` | text |  | The stable copy id. |
| `--request-id ID` | text |  | The durable request id. |
| `--custody CLASS` | enum: clio, operator, caller, peer, review_output, unknown |  | The copy custody class. |
| `--owner harness\|system` | enum: harness, system |  | The copy disposition owner. |
| `--required-action erase\|remove\|delivery\|notice` | enum: erase, remove, delivery, notice |  | The action the copy requires. |
| `--state STATE` | text |  | The copy state, including the outcome. |
| `--exception-reason REASON` | text |  | Why the copy has no request result yet. |
| `--updated-at TIME` | text |  | The last update time (RFC 3339 UTC; defaults to now). |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio compliance request-copy --copy-id c1 --request-id r1 --custody clio --owner harness --required-action erase --state pending
```

```
clio compliance request-copy --copy-id c1 --request-id r1 --custody peer --owner system --required-action notice --state open -o json
```
